name: install a scientific framework into the venv from source
definition: build and install the framework so it is importable within that venv and its helper components resolve.
failure_mode: incomplete build/install makes the example import fail at runtime

name: install an offscreen software-rendering stack (OSMesa-based) without root access
definition: Set up a python rendering environment that uses OSMesa for headless GL, working under an unprivileged user on a server with no display.
failure_mode: No OSMesa context available under the unprivileged user; render fails

name: install and import a lightweight blockchain-query python stack
definition: provision the required python clients for retrieving chain data as well as a web microframework and a requests library so a service can start.
failure_mode: a missing or unimportable library prevents the service from starting.

name: install and launch a jupyter notebook server
definition: install the notebooks package and start it as a persistent background process
failure_mode: server dies, binds the wrong interface, or never starts so the port is closed
